name: tactician
description: Generates dynamic Workflow scripts on demand. /tactician:make <task> classifies the task into an orchestration archetype (understand, design, review, research, migrate, generic), picks the fan-out topology (pipeline by default, a barrier only when a stage needs all prior results), and writes a self-contained Workflow script that obeys the Workflow tool's hard rules: a pure-literal meta block, schema'd agent returns instead of text parsing, .filter(Boolean) after fan-out, adversarial verification for findings, loop-until-dry or loop-until-budget for unknown-size work, isolation:'worktree' only for parallel file mutation, and no Date.now or Math.random. Every script is validated with `node --check` and a 14-point self-audit before it is saved to .claude/workflows/ or run.
